transformation: Segment-indexed feature table extracted from cldf/parameters.csv of the PHOIBLE CLDF StructureDataset at tag v2.0.1. The release is established from the maintainer's direct knowledge of having produced it, and corroborated by diff on 2026-08-13: 3,125 of 3,142 graphemes match after NFD normalization and U+0261 -> U+0067 folding. Of 115,625 comparable feature cells, 95.43% are accounted for by the intended transformation: 82,260 agree exactly, 24,289 map upstream '0' (not applicable) to '.', and 3,788 collapse upstream contour values such as '+,-' to '.'. The remaining 5,187 cells are extraction inconsistencies, recorded here because they are real and NOT yet fixed: 3,729 cells where upstream says '0' were written '-' instead of '.', 761 where upstream specifies '+' or '-' were written '.', and 697 where upstream gives a contour were resolved to a single '+' or '-'.
citation: Moran, Steven & McCloy, Daniel (eds.) 2019. PHOIBLE 2.0. Jena: Max Planck Institute for the Science of Human History. https://phoible.org/
